# Slideshow

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSlideshow` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideshow.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSlideshow.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSlideshow.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A gallery or a timed slideshow

## Overview

Renders itself: image layers, info panel and indicators are all painted directly inside Render() — no child UI elements are created. This keeps the animation cheap (just opacity tweens) and lets the indicator drawing switch on a single enum.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSlideshow> CreateSlideshow( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UCElementDescriptor MakeSlideshowDescriptor();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSlideshow(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasSlideshow(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasSlideshow(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `SlideshowFadeStyle`

(Suffixed because X11/Xlib.h defines None/True/False as preprocessor macros.)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoFade` | Instant swap |
| `CrossFade` | Both layers visible, sums to 1.0 |
| `FadeOutIn` | Old fades fully out, then new fades in |
| `SlideHorizontal` | Old slides left while new slides in from the right |
| `SlideVertical` | Old slides up while new slides in from the bottom |
| `ZoomFade` | New slide zooms in from slightly enlarged while cross-fading |

### enum `SlideshowTextMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Static` | infoTitle/infoBody set once, never animated |
| `PerSlide` | Text swaps with each slide, fades with the image |

### enum `SlideshowInfoLayout`

"Split" layouts give the panel its own region and shrink the image to the remainder. "Overlay" layouts float the panel on top of a full-bleed image with a translucent scrim behind the text.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` | No info panel — full-bleed image |
| `SplitLeft` | Split — panel owns its region, image takes the rest Panel left, image right |
| `SplitRight` | Panel right, image left (legacy default look) |
| `SplitTop` | Panel top, image below |
| `SplitBottom` | Panel bottom, image above |
| `OverlayLeft` | Overlay edges — panel spans one edge of the image |
| `OverlayRight` |  |
| `OverlayTop` |  |
| `OverlayBottom` |  |
| `OverlayTopLeft` | Overlay corners — panel is a floating box anchored in a corner |
| `OverlayTopRight` |  |
| `OverlayBottomLeft` |  |
| `OverlayBottomRight` |  |
| `OverlayCenter` | Overlay center / full Floating box centered over the image |
| `OverlayFull` | Scrim across the whole image |

### enum `SlideshowGapFill`

Reuses the framework's ImageFitMode for the actual scaling policy: Cover — auto-zoom + auto-crop to fill (no gaps, crops overflow) Contain — fit entirely inside, preserving aspect (leaves gaps) Fill — stretch to the exact area (distorts aspect) ScaleDown — like Contain but never upscale NoScale — native pixel size, centered by the focal point The focal point (0..1) chooses which part survives a crop / where a smaller image sits. GapFill decides what shows behind letterboxed images.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BackgroundColor` | reuse config.backgroundColor |
| `LetterboxColor` | use config.letterboxColor |
| `BlurredImage` | a zoomed copy of the same image, softened by a scrim |

### enum `SlideshowIndicatorShape`

Matches the eight indicator styles offered by the slideshow widget. (Hidden instead of None because X11 defines None as a macro.)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` | Indicators hidden |
| `Dots` | Classic round dots (filled = active) |
| `Bars` | Short rectangles / pill bars — default |
| `ProgressBar` | Single bar that grows across slideDuration |
| `StoryBars` | One bar per slide, each fills over its own slot (Instagram Stories) |
| `Counter` | Plain "3 / 7" text |
| `Thumbnails` | Tiny preview of each slide's image |
| `Labels` | Per-slide text label, tab-style underline on active |

### enum `SlideshowIndicatorEdge`

Top/Bottom lay the items out in a row; Left/Right stack them in a column.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bottom` | default |
| `Top` |  |
| `Left` |  |
| `Right` |  |
